Class Ray

java.lang.Object
primitives.Ray
public final class Ray extends Object
Represents a ray in 3D space, which is a half-line defined by a starting point and a direction vector.

  • Constructor Details

    • Ray

      public Ray(Point origin, Vector direction)
      Constructs a ray with a given starting point and direction. The direction vector is normalized before assignment.
      Parameters:
      origin - the starting point of the ray
      direction - the direction vector of the ray

    • findClosestPoint

      public Point findClosestPoint(List<Point> points)
      Finds the closest point to the ray's origin from a given list of points. Uses a stream to wrap points into Intersections and calls findClosestIntersection.
      Parameters:
      points - list of intersection points
      Returns:
      the closest point, or null if the list is empty/null
